title: bioinfo-kaust/hybrid-metatranscriptomics pipeline - params.input / params.assembly_input schema
description: Paired-end short reads, one row per lane. Rows sharing a sample name are merged. The factor column named by --condition_column (default 'condition') is required in --input and ignored in --assembly_input.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

condition.errorMessage: Condition/group label. Required in --input when --condition_column is 'condition' (the default); may be empty in --assembly_input

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 must be provided (this pipeline is paired-end), cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
